_comment: MXM Thanks EG's collection roles. Only controls whose meaning matches a role are claimed.
osc1.wave is Model, the engine; osc1.tune is Frequency, the coarse pitch about the note.
amp_env.decay is the gate's decay: at Init a note pings the gate, and Gate decay is how long
it rings. Its other envelope roles stay empty: the gate has no attack, sustain or release, and
no envelope reaches the sound until a route aims one there.
voice.note_priority is the voice mode (Poly, Mono, Legato), a key assign.
No filter role: there is no filter. Harmonics, Timbre and Morph have no role in the standard.
No route amount is claimed: a slot moves with its routing, so no knob could keep one meaning.
lfo1.sync and lfo2.sync stay empty, as on every instrument until the collection maps syncs.
